propositions: The rebar-brainstorm skill documentation lacks explicit guidance that a blocked or not-yet-claimable ticket has completed the current review cycle successfully and requires no further agent action until rebar ready resurfaces it.
Agents are observed rationalizing repeated uses of rebar review-plan --force on blocked tickets from vague instructions, collectively defeating the plan-review gate's intended fast-fail behavior.

The skill documentation must prohibit rebar review-plan --force as an agent move and frame it as a human-operator-only escape hatch, requiring agents to ask a clarifying question instead of inferring authorization.
A forced review of a ticket with unresolved dependencies creates a signed attestation that becomes silently stale, posing a risk to the integrity of the review cycle.
